objective: Establish which pi packages the 0.3.0 Pi integration depends on actually resolve from the npm registry or GitHub in this environment, with their latest versions, peer dependencies and entry layout, and whether pi itself runs here.
scope: Work only in a new empty directory /home/user/holyagent-notes/pi-probe (create it; the ownership path below names it nominally because ownership paths must be repository-relative); never write inside /home/user/holyagent or /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0.

For each package, report: resolves or not, the latest stable version and its publish date, the version range of @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent it supports (peerDependencies or engines), its license, and its pi manifest (the pi key in package.json or extensions/, skills/, prompts/ directories). Packages: @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent (is 1.5.0 published?), @earendil-works/pi-ai, @earendil-works/pi-agent-core, @earendil-works/pi-tui, typebox, @tintinweb/pi-subagents, @juicesharp/rpiv-todo, @juicesharp/rpiv-ask-user-question, pi-web-kit, @aliou/pi-processes, billion-context, @amaster.ai/pi-computer-use, and pi-provider-kimi-code (npm, or GitHub Leechael/pi-provider-kimi-code). Use `bun pm view <pkg> --json` or `npm view <pkg> --json` (whichever works; the registry goes through the session proxy).

Install @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@1.5.0 (or the newest if 1.5.0 is absent) locally in the probe directory with `bun add` or `npm install --ignore-scripts`, run its binary with --version and --help, and save the help output plus the RPC-mode, extensions and packages documentation it ships (look for docs/ in the installed package) to files in the probe directory. Also record node --version.

Install the other packages into the probe directory too and copy each package's README into /home/user/holyagent-notes/pi-probe/readmes/<name>.md, so implementers can read the API; for @tintinweb/pi-subagents, pi-provider-kimi-code, the rpiv packages and billion-context also note their extension entry file names and the tools and events they register.
constraints: No changes to the repositories. No live model calls and no logins.
Write the full findings to /home/user/holyagent-notes/pi-deps.md as a table plus notes; the report stays under 300 words and points to it.

criteria.text: Findings file: /home/user/holyagent-notes/pi-deps.md lists every named package with resolves, version, date, pi range, license and manifest
